messages:
Nina: Need a quick integration plan for SeasideRetail demo. Requirements: websocket SDK streaming, server-side function callbacks that post structured order JSON, idempotency guidance, plus a two-week pricing ballpark at ~450 rps. Can infra + legal chime in? @arjun @claire
Arjun: We support WS + SSE. For 450 rps steady (spikes ~900) recommend websocket. Key items: immediate 200 ack, idempotency via call_id+order_id, Retry-After handling on 429.
Claire: SDK advice: enable client batching (batch_size=5) and server TTL=25ms. Also suggest prefix cache for repeated prompts to cut token spend. Small JS snippet below for ack pattern.
Arjun: Example envelope (single line): {"type":"func_call","id":"fc_900","name":"create_order","payload":{"order_id":"S-100","items":[{"sku":"Z1","qty":2}]},"trace":"t-44"}
Claire: JS sketch:
```js
ws.on('func_call', msg => { ws.ack(msg.id); fetch(WEBHOOK, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(msg.payload)}); });
```
Nina: Telemetry ask: they want trace propagation. We'll pass X-Trace-Id through and include token usage in callback headers if they opt in.
Sam-Legal: Note: if payload contains PII we need the questionnaire signed and confirmation on retention. For demo, offer anonymized payloads if they need faster approval.
DeployBot: Presales cluster created: `presales-seaside` (6xA10G). Ingress cap 1500 qps, burst 2k. Console: https://console.redwood/presales-seaside
Arjun: Ops best-practices: 1) make webhooks idempotent for 48h, 2) set retry limit 5 with expo backoff + jitter, 3) DLQ for failed deliveries.
Claire: Pricing: I'll draft a quick hosted estimate for 2 weeks at 450 rps with avg 100/50 tokens and share in Slack thread. We can offer up to $3k trial credits pending sales ops sign-off.
Nina: Action items: Claire publish SDK sample + batching notes, Arjun publish webhook retry headers and idempotency examples, Sam-Legal send security questionnaire, Nina will schedule kickoff Wednesday 11am PT. Any blockers?
Sam-Legal: Confirm whether webhook will receive PII. If yes, start SOC2 review. If no, proceed.
Nina: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
